IT DOES SETTLE ONE THING THE FLOOR PLAN LEFT OPEN: the bedroom hierarchy. REWRITTEN 2026-07-28 (recording a reversal): ห้องนอน 2 gets a double bed; ห้องนอน 3 is the FULLY furnished room -- bed (double-width symbol), two side tables, sofa with low table, desk/shelf and a wardrobe; and แต่งตัว is a pure dressing room with two FACING wardrobe runs and a stool, NO bed (the first pass put a 'single bed' there -- that symbol is the sofa, and it is in ห้องนอน 3). A-06 gives all three the same 1/+3.40/(1) tag and no way to tell them apart.
The A-03 brief asks that a bedroom have space for a double bed ('ควรมีพื้นที่สำหรับเตียงคู่'); this sheet is where that is demonstrated.
Everything east of grid 3 is drawn as ROOF, hatched, exactly as on A-06 -- the single-storey wing's hip roof and the metal-sheet roof over the car port. No floor exists there at this level.
Levels repeat A-06 (+3.40 rooms, +3.35 bathroom, +3.30 balcony). Room tags are again name-and-level only, without the finish numbers A-06 carries.
No furniture is dimensioned and no schedule accompanies it, so only presence and rough position are recoverable.
